product_plans_cost_check.name: product_plans_cost_check
product_plans_cost_check.value: ("product_plans"."target_cost_amount" is null and "product_plans"."target_cost_currency" is null) or ("product_plans"."target_cost_amount" >= 0 and "product_plans"."target_cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

skus_cost_check.name: skus_cost_check
skus_cost_check.value: ("skus"."unit_cost_amount" is null and "skus"."unit_cost_currency" is null) or ("skus"."unit_cost_amount" >= 0 and "skus"."unit_cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

supplier_candidates_cost_check.name: supplier_candidates_cost_check
supplier_candidates_cost_check.value: ("supplier_candidates"."quoted_cost_amount" is null and "supplier_candidates"."quoted_cost_currency" is null) or ("supplier_candidates"."quoted_cost_amount" >= 0 and "supplier_candidates"."quoted_cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

marketplace_publication_requests_followu.name: marketplace_publication_requests_followup_check
marketplace_publication_requests_followu.value: ("marketplace_publication_requests"."action" in ('amazon_validation_preview', 'etsy_create_draft') and "marketplace_publication_requests"."parent_request_id" is null and "marketplace_publication_requests"."source_external_listing_id" is null) or ("marketplace_publication_requests"."action" = 'amazon_submit' and "marketplace_publication_requests"."parent_request_id" is not null and "marketplace_publication_requests"."source_external_listing_id" is null) or ("marketplace_publication_requests"."action" = 'etsy_activate' and "marketplace_publication_requests"."parent_request_id" is not null and "marketplace_publication_requests"."source_external_listing_id" is not null)

order_ingestion_runs_counts_check.name: order_ingestion_runs_counts_check
order_ingestion_runs_counts_check.value: "order_ingestion_runs"."collected_count" >= 0 and ("order_ingestion_runs"."reported_count" is null or "order_ingestion_runs"."reported_count" >= 0) and "order_ingestion_runs"."duplicate_count" >= 0 and "order_ingestion_runs"."risk_count" >= 0

order_line_catalog_links_target_check.name: order_line_catalog_links_target_check
order_line_catalog_links_target_check.value: "order_line_catalog_links"."sku_id" is not null or ("order_line_catalog_links"."listing_id" is not null and "order_line_catalog_links"."listing_version_id" is not null)
